description_en: Modifies a global policy that is associated with a cloud resource
description_zh: 修改与云资源绑定的无地域策略
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-resource-center-policy --resource-type desktop --resource-ids ecd-00001 --resource-region-id cn-hangzhou --product-type desktop --policy-group-type general --policy-group-ids pg-gx2x1dhsmthe90000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyResourceCenterPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The resource type.

Valid values:

app: cloud applications.

desktop: cloud computers
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The resource IDs. You can specify up to 100 resource IDs
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID列表。
可设置0\~100个
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resource
parameters.name: resource_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The service type.

Valid values:

app: cloud applications.

resourceGroup: resource groups.

desktop: cloud computers.

desktopGroup: cloud computer shares
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en:
The policy type.

Valid values:

general: a general policy
parameters.name: policy_group_type

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the cloud computer policies that you want to associate with cloud computers.

You can specify up to one cloud computer policy that takes effect globally, and up to four cloud computer policies that apply to specific IP addresses. If multiple cloud computer policies are configured for global enforcement, only the earliest-associated policy will take effect
parameters.help_zh:
需要绑定的云电脑策略ID列表。

最多可以填写1条全局生效的云电脑策略和4条针对指定IP生效的云电脑策略。如果填写的全局生效的云电脑策略超过1条，则仅第1条生效
parameters.name: policy_group_ids
